POV: you drove past the resort strip and found Hộ Quốc Temple instead.

4.7 stars. 1,488 reviews. And most tourists never make it here.

The dragons on the gate alone are worth the detour. Incense smoke, terraced pavilions, ocean views behind the altars. It hits different when you're the only foreigner in the frame.

Add this to your itinerary before you book another beach club.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
